title: Fresno, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Fresno, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Fresno is a city in CA with a population of 542,107. Agricultural capital with proximity to Yosemite, cheaper than coastal CA, but hot summers. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 267 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.4.
